messages:
deploybot: schedule: packaging -> escort-lane for private-installer:v2.4.0 (canary=12, window=01:45-03:15 UTC, escrow+0m)

sara_devex: FYI enterprise asked for a 01:45 start. keeping small canary to reduce blast radius. anyone see blockers?

mike_packaging: shrinkwrap grew by ~22MB due to additional telemetry assets. transport will be ~+8m on slow mirrors. also added a preflight check that probes local PKCS#11 endpoints.

nate_sre: probe sounds fine, but last week older HSM proxies timed out during preflight in QA. suggest we add a soft-fail flag and log detailed trace. if soft-fail triggers >2% across canary -> abort.

frank_ops: KMS windows open at 01:40 UTC. cosign signer pool size is 3, avg sign latency ~90s. i'll bump signer pool to 6 for the next hour.

kate_release: release notes draft uploaded to /docs/releases/v2.4.0-draft.md with airgap steps, manual install guidance, and a breaking-change note for HSM older proxies. @releasenotes-bot paste short checklist here?

releasenotes-bot: checklist:
- cosign signatures validated for all .tar.gz / .zip artifacts
- manifest sha256s computed and recorded
- transport escort lane & ETA confirmed
- KMS signer window and pool size approved
- release notes entry + manual remediation steps added

sara_devex: quick sha256 outputs from my staging machine:
```
$ sha256sum private-installer-v2.4.0.tar.gz
8e2c3a1b...  private-installer-v2.4.0.tar.gz
$ sha256sum offline-epoch-2026-04-02.tar.gz
9f4b7c2d...  offline-epoch-2026-04-02.tar.gz
```

mike_packaging: cosign verify on signing cluster:
```
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/pack-sign private-installer-v2.4.0.tar.gz
Verification for private-installer-v2.4.0.tar.gz OK
Signed by: cosign:redwood-pack-v2
```

nate_sre: controls: if cosign verification fails during delivery -> immediate abort + pin to private-installer:v2.3.9. that is our safe fallback. also alert if install failure rate >2% during canary window.

frank_ops: escort ETA: first shard 01:52 UTC, bulk 02:08 UTC. if mirrors degrade we might need +10m contingency. request approval from oncall for contingency.

zoe_support: prepping support KB with the manual remediation steps (how to bypass preflight and run manual PKCS#11 check). will link in notes.

deploybot: action queued: /deploy promote --pkg=private-installer:v2.4.0 --canary=12 --canary-duration=25m --window=01:45-03:15 --escrow=0m

(01:45 UTC)
sara_devex: starting canary now. attaching quick health tail in 10m.

(25m later)
sara_devex: canary report:
- total installs: 12
- failures: 1 (8.3%)
- failure detail: PKCS#11 probe timeout on host with HSM proxy v1.0.6
- cosign verify: all OK

nate_sre: 8.3% > threshold (2%). initiating abort and pin to v2.3.9 per rollback gate.

deploybot: executing abort -> pin private-installer to v2.3.9; revoke staging artifacts for v2.4.0; sending notifications to #eng-releases, #support, and #eng-oncall.

kate_release: updated release notes: aborted cutover entry, root-cause hypothesis (HSM proxy version skew), and immediate mitigation steps (manual install instructions + ticket to update proxy fleet). linking KB: https://internal/release-kb/v2.4.0-abort

mike_packaging: republishing a delta patch that disables the preflight PKCS#11 probe on older proxies is possible, but we need to coordinate a proxy-version sweep. i'll open PR and ping infra for a proxy-rollback plan.

frank_ops: signer pool scaled back to normal. cosign queue nominal.

zoe_support: created support ticket template for customers who hit the preflight timeout during manual install.

kate_release: flagging follow-up release: v2.4.0-1 with preflight relaxed, target after proxy sweep. documenting canary thresholds and contingency in release_notes.md.

sara_devex: closing thread. we'll reconvene after infra proxy updates; thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
